name: Strata
cost: Free (MIT). No account and no cloud
works_with: Windows, Linux and macOS. Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode and other apps that speak the OpenAI or Anthropic API
short: Runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a 125B model that normally needs a server, on a gaming PC and serves it to your apps on localhost.
what: Strata makes a 125-billion-parameter model fit on a normal PC by splitting it across your graphics card, your RAM and your SSD. It chats, writes code and reads pictures. It serves the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs on `127.0.0.1:8080`, so coding agents can use it in place of a cloud model. You can run it as a desktop app or as the `strata` command in a terminal.
who: People with a gaming PC or Apple Silicon Mac who want a strong model running locally, with their chats and files staying on their own machine. Skip it if you have less than 32 GB of RAM and graphics memory together, or no room for a download of 40 to 70 GB.
needs: At least 32 GB of RAM and graphics memory (VRAM) together. 64 GB of RAM runs every size
An NVIDIA RTX 20 series or newer, an AMD Radeon RX 6800 or newer, Intel Arc, or an Apple Silicon Mac on macOS 15 or newer
About 80 GB of free disk. An SSD makes the first start much faster
Windows 10 or 11, Linux or macOS, with a current graphics driver
On Linux, FUSE 2 for the AppImage (`libfuse2` or `libfuse2t64`)

steps.title: Install the app
steps.text: Download the file for your system and graphics card from the releases page. For NVIDIA, take `cuda13` if your driver is 580 or newer, otherwise `cuda12`. The `hip` and `amd` files are for AMD cards. On Windows run the `.exe`, on Linux `chmod +x` the AppImage and start it, on a Mac drag Strata to Applications.

steps.title: Pick a model
steps.text: On the first screen the app reads your PC and recommends a model that fits. Press install. The download continues where it stopped if it is interrupted.

steps.title: Or install the terminal version (Linux and Mac)
steps.text: This pipes a script into your shell. The README shows how to download it with `-o install.sh` and read it first.

steps.title: Or install the terminal version (Windows PowerShell)
steps.text: Open a new terminal window afterwards.

steps.title: Start serving
steps.text: It asks one question at a time: model, context, pictures and who may connect. Then it downloads the engine and the model and starts serving.

steps.title: Connect your coding agent
steps.text: OpenAI-compatible apps use `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1`. Anthropic API apps use `http://127.0.0.1:8080` without `/v1`. This command prints the exact settings for OpenCode, Codex CLI, Claude Code and others.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Set up Strata on this PC for me: https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata - follow docs/AI_SETUP.md in that repository.

watch: The one-line installers pipe a script straight into your shell. Read the script first.
The Windows installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows shows a "Windows protected your PC" warning.
The model is a big download: about 40 to 70 GB.
While the model starts, your PC can be slow or stop responding for 1 to 3 minutes. Strata loads 35 to 55 GB into RAM.
The app's chat can work in a folder on your PC. In Manual mode it asks before it changes a file or runs a command.
Web search in the chat is the one feature that sends something off your PC: the search words.
`strata launch --access lan` opens it to your phone or other PCs. It makes an API key by default, and `--no-api-key` turns that off.
